NDT inspection management ERP in Aiken: one system for nuclear, manufacturing and utility work

An NDT inspection management ERP in Aiken has to meet the documentation standards of nuclear-sector clients while still running efficiently for day-to-day industrial work at tire, tissue and power plants. The Atlantis ERP solution keeps technician certifications, vision tests, radiation profiles, instrument calibration, procedures, crew scheduling, reports, quotes and invoices in one place. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable, quote on request.

The Central Savannah River Area is an unusual inspection market. The Savannah River Site dominates it: a Department of Energy complex that runs H Canyon, the only industrial-scale nuclear reprocessing facility in the country; the tritium facilities that recycle and purify tritium for the stockpile; the Savannah River National Laboratory; and the conversion of the unfinished former MOX building into the Savannah River Plutonium Processing Facility, planned to produce plutonium pits by the mid-2030s. Across the river, Plant Vogtle's four units near Waynesboro make up the largest nuclear generating site in the country. Alongside all of that, Aiken County has a large manufacturing base: Bridgestone's two tire plants between Graniteville and the Edgefield County line, and Kimberly-Clark's Beech Island plant, the largest in its network and currently expanding.

An NDT company here might be staffing weld inspection on a nuclear construction package one week and boiler, pressure vessel and steam-line work at a manufacturing plant the next. The rulebooks differ, but the questions behind them are the same: was the technician qualified, was the instrument calibrated, which procedure revision was used, and who approved the result? This section covers how the Atlantis ERP answers those questions, sticking to the features the software actually has.

Why nuclear-sector documentation changes how an Aiken NDT company runs its office

Nuclear and DOE-sector clients expect every inspection record to be traceable to a qualified person, a calibrated instrument and a controlled procedure revision. That is hard to prove from spreadsheets. The Atlantis ERP stores each of those as a dated, linked record, so the trace is a lookup rather than an investigation.

Prime contractors and their subcontractors at nuclear sites usually operate under quality programmes that flow requirements down to every supplier, including NDT subcontractors. The details are set in each contract, and the ERP doesn't claim to certify you against any of them. What it does is keep the evidence those programmes ask for: certification records with issue and expiry dates and attachments, calibration certificates with accredited-lab details and results, procedures with full revision history and locked approved revisions, and reports signed by inspector, reviewer and approver.

This matters to the rest of the business too. A company that can trace a nuclear-package report back to the instrument serial and the procedure revision can do the same for a tissue-plant boiler job, and manufacturing clients notice when your records are cleaner than your competitors'. Running both kinds of work on one system also means you don't keep a strict set of records for nuclear jobs and a loose set for everything else. If you want to see that trace done live with your own data, ask for an Aiken traceability demo.

Technician certification tracking software with vision, exam and radiation records

For an Aiken inspection company, certification tracking covers more than a certificate and its expiry. The Atlantis ERP holds each certification with scheme, level, method, certifying body, dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours and exam results, alongside separate vision test records, exam sheets and a radiation profile for each technician.

Schemes include SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other, with levels from trainee to III. Status updates automatically to active, expiring soon (90 days), expired or revoked, and the Expiring Soon and Expired menus give the quality manager a daily worklist. Certificate templates per scheme set the validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required and the minimum OJT and training hours, so the programme's rules are applied every time a certificate is added.

Examination sheets record general, specific and practical scores against a passing score (70% by default, adjustable to your written practice) with the exam files attached, which is what a client auditor reviewing your Level III's certification decisions will ask for. Vision tests hold near vision to Jaeger J1 or J2, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and certificate file, each with its own expiry and alert.

The employee NDT profile shows highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Warning tasks are created 90 days before certificate or vision test expiry, daily email alerts go to the people you choose, and a timesheet flags any hours booked by a technician whose certificate isn't valid. See the certificates app.

Radiography crews, sources and vehicles across South Carolina and Georgia

Radiography work in the CSRA means crews, sources and vehicles regularly crossing the Savannah River between South Carolina and Georgia. Both are NRC Agreement States with their own radioactive materials licensing. The Atlantis ERP keeps the people, equipment and vehicle side of that in order, and licence-specific requirements are configured during implementation.

On the people side, the NDT profile records radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry next to the RT certification, and warnings work the same way as for certificates. On the equipment side, source-related items are tracked by serial number with an assigned person, condition, lifecycle state and movement records. Issue and return need supervisor and manager approval, reservations prevent two crews planning on the same item, and inbound and outbound movements are logged, so you can show who had a camera or survey meter and when.

The Fleet app records whether each vehicle can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and which project and driver it is assigned to, with dates and mileage. When a coordinator books an RT crew for a job at a Georgia utility site, the right technician, source-related equipment and source-capable vehicle all sit on the same assignment, and the system stops the same technician or equipment serial being double-booked.

RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement. Computed radiography has its own report type too. See the fleet app and the asset management app.

Calibration management software that proves an instrument was in calibration on the day

The calibration question a nuclear-sector auditor asks is never just whether an instrument is in calibration now. It is whether it was in calibration on the day the report was signed. The Atlantis ERP keeps the full calibration history per serial number with provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date, so that question has a direct answer.

The calibration certificate register stores each lab's accreditation number, the certificate PDF and a valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Purchase records can classify vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab, with an accredited-lab flag, accreditation number and expiry, and a purchase line can be tied to the exact equipment serial being calibrated or repaired. If a lab's accreditation lapses, the record shows it before an auditor finds it.

Each instrument carries equipment type, asset tag, firmware, accessories, condition and a lifecycle state (new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed). The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement work, with condition before and after, which helps when a result is questioned after a firmware change. When a scheduler assigns an out-of-calibration instrument, the team assignment shows a warning.

Consumables such as penetrant, developer, particle bath and couplant are tracked with reorder levels, a low-stock flag and a movement ledger. For PT and MT, batch traceability is often asked about, and the ledger shows what was issued to which job.

Procedures under revision control for nuclear and industrial clients

Procedure control is where a nuclear-sector audit usually starts. The Atlantis ERP keeps a procedure register where every revision is snapshotted, approved revisions are locked, and each step from draft to published is recorded with who did it and when.

Each procedure records document number, revision, method (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and others), scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and either the body text or an uploaded file. The workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected (a reason is required) and archived states. Prepared-by, reviewed-by and approved-by are all dated, and email reminders keep approvals from stalling.

Nuclear-sector work often means writing a new technique-specific procedure for a client's specification. The ERP can generate an AI-assisted first draft, with a built-in template as fallback, and your Level III reviews, edits and approves it. The software handles the layout and the Level III makes the technical decisions. NCR and CAPA workflows can be configured during implementation, so a finding can be traced to the procedure revision that fixed it.

Every NDT report references the procedure and standard used, so the chain from report to procedure revision is always there. See the procedures app.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for site badging and planned outages

Scheduling in the CSRA is shaped by site access. Nuclear and DOE sites need badging and site-specific training before a technician gets through the gate, and plant outages come with fixed windows. The Atlantis ERP handles each job as a team assignment that moves from planned to dispatched to in field to submitted to closed, and blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment.

The technician availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, and blocks overlaps. Leave from time off requests feeds in automatically. Recording site training days on the calendar means they count as unavailable time, which matters when site orientation takes several days before a technician can do any billable work. Projects carry safety induction and work permit fields, so the coordinator can see who has already completed a client's induction before assigning them.

Assignments include site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. Technician status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date are visible in calendar, kanban and list views. For a planned outage at Vogtle or a shutdown at a manufacturing plant, the coordinator can see weeks ahead which qualified people and calibrated instruments are free, and the out-of-calibration warning flags any instrument that will need recalibration before the window.

Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup separately, by method, site, client and equipment serial, with approval before billing. See the team assignments app.

NDT reporting software with three signatures and offline capture

For clients who scrutinise records, NDT reporting software has to enforce review and approval, not just produce a PDF. The Atlantis ERP moves every report through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures, plus a third-party or authorised inspector name and signature where needed.

There are 17 report types (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography), each with its own numbering sequence. Method-specific data is built in, such as the UT probe calibration table, RT source and IQI details, MT particle type, PT developer, PAUT focal laws and UT thickness readings by direction, along with weld and job lines that record defect type and orientation. References to work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard are captured on each report.

The offline field app works where there's no signal, which covers a lot of shielded buildings, tank interiors and plant basements. It stores drafts and photos locally, takes on-screen signatures and syncs later. Versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your logo and layout, and a client's own Excel form can be filled automatically through field-to-cell mapping.

For manufacturing and utility clients who want findings shown on a 3D model with thickness and remaining-life trends, Atlantis Digital Twins adds that layer. Reporting is also available on its own as Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Quoting and invoicing for prime contractors and plant purchasing departments

Prime contractors and large manufacturers pay quickly when the invoice matches their PO exactly and slowly when it doesn't. The Atlantis ERP builds invoices from approved timesheets, with the project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector in the header and labour, equipment and consumables shown separately.

Quotations hold job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF. Once accepted and signed online, a quotation becomes a sales order and a project with the client PO, contract, methods, scope, acceptance criteria and assigned people and equipment attached. Tasks can record method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, and procedure and WPS references, so the invoice backup and the technical record come from the same data.

Invoice lines can show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours, which fits clients who want charges broken down by work package. Travel and per diem costs come in through the Expenses app and can be re-billed. South Carolina and Georgia tax settings are configured during implementation. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over 12 months. See the invoicing app.

Integrations, CRM and implementation

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections. Scope is agreed per implementation. That covers a small Aiken company keeping QuickBooks as well as a subcontractor that has to deliver data into a prime contractor's systems. Field devices use their own endpoints for assigned jobs, issued equipment, report submission and sync.

The CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector and estimated technicians and days, and scores leads 0 to 100. Contacts from a supplier outreach event or a regional manufacturing meeting can be captured with the business card app and turned into leads in one click. Dashboards cover calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring or expired, and equipment overdue for return.

Implementation usually starts with certificates, vision tests and calibration records, because those are what clients audit first. Team assignments, field reports, procedures and commercial apps follow. Atlantis NDT does the setup and support directly, led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III. If you host internal SNT-TC-1A-based training, the eLearning app and Practical NDT simulator can support it. Request an Aiken implementation scope.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT inspection management ERP for an Aiken company doing nuclear-sector work?

One that keeps certifications, exam and vision records, calibration history, procedure revisions and signed reports as linked, dated records. The Atlantis ERP does this for NDT companies and is fully customizable to each client's flow-down requirements.

Does the ERP certify us to a nuclear quality programme?

No. It keeps the records those programmes ask for. Meeting a specific contract's quality requirements is still your programme's responsibility, and the ERP is configured to support it during implementation.

Can it track radiation badges and source-capable vehicles?

Yes. The employee NDT profile holds radiation safety training and badge number, and the Fleet app holds source-carrying capability and transport licence expiry.

Can we prove an instrument was calibrated on a past date?

Yes. Calibration history is kept per serial number with certificate, result and due date, and every report and assignment references the equipment used.

Does Atlantis offer NDT training?

Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training only. The ERP can record certificates under other schemes, such as ISO 9712, PCN or CSWIP.

How do we get pricing?

Pricing is quote on request. Request an Aiken quote with your headcount, methods and client mix.
